conclusion.quote: Reported hypothesis outcome: not supported.** The analysis uses the complete 54-person equal-indifference sample, checks map checksums, geometry and finite values, fits the participant-level one-sample model, and controls positive whole-brain inference with 9,999 sign-flip maximum-t permutations. It defines vmPFC independently with a broad AAL3v2 medial orbital frontal/rectus proxy and reports that no proxy voxel survives whole-brain FWE (minimum corrected p = 0.788). The proxy mean is −0.0037 contrast units (95% CI −0.0287 to 0.0212); this is consistent with a lack of positive support, not proof of a zero effect. The reported whole-brain corrected clusters are posterior (peaks y = −94 to −102 mm), so they do not support the vmPFC hypothesis. See [report](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/judge-targets/narps-neutral-r1-21-j01/content/workspace/report/report.md), [analysis plan](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/judge-targets/narps-neutral-r1-21-j01/content/workspace/protocol/analysis-plan.md), [analysis code](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/judge-targets/narps-neutral-r1-21-j01/content/workspace/code/analyze.py), and [summary results](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/judge-targets/narps-neutral-r1-21-j01/content/workspace/results/summary.json).
